headline: Nvidia to invest up to $3 billion in Stargate data center developer Lancium, the Information reports
summary: Nvidia  will invest up to $3 billion in power infrastructure developer Lancium, the company ‌behind the Stargate data center campus in Texas, ‌the Information reported on Friday.  • The chipmaker will invest an initial $2 ​billion for a stake of roughly 20% in Lancium, which is backed by Blackstone, according to the report.  • Nvidia could invest an additional $1 billion if the ‌company meets certain ⁠thresholds, including grid hookups, the report said, citing people familiar with the matter.
